title: androrchis pinetorum
intro: Androrchis pinetorum, commonly known as the pine orchid, is a plant species in the orchid family (Orchidaceae) that has been traditionally used in folk medicine. The health benefits of Androrchis pinetorum include its use in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to relax bronchial muscles, reduce inflammation, and expel mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Androrchis pinetorum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
